concept.title: A Little Extra
concept.bigIdea: October at Chef Sandy's Kitchen comes with a little extra on every plate.
concept.whyNow: Students are back on campus and short on time; a simple, generous offer gives them a reason to text an order this month.
concept.keyMessage: Fresh, hygienic West African food, a text away.

hook: Your lunch is one text away.
Rich. Spicy. Tender. Ready in minutes.
This is what home tastes like in Buea.
Comfort on your plate, delivered hot.

offer.framing: Refer ten friends this month and your next plate is on us.
offer.terms: Refer 10, get your next plate free
offer.riskReversal: Every plate is cooked fresh to the same hygiene standard.

shortVideo.script:
SEGMENT 1 (0-10s)
Visual: Steam rises from a plate of pepper stew.
On screen: Chef Sandy's Kitchen
Voice: Hungry between lectures? Chef Sandy's Kitchen cooks it fresh, rich, spicy and tender, right here in Buea.

SEGMENT 2 (10-20s)
Visual: Sandy plates golden fried plantains.
On screen: Cooked fresh. Delivered hot.
Voice: Every plate is made to the same hygiene standard, and it reaches your door hot or waits for you on the go.

SEGMENT 3 (20-30s)
Visual: A student grins and takes a first bite.
On screen: Text to order
Voice: Refer ten friends this October and your next plate is free. Text Chef Sandy's Kitchen now.
